_comment: A retraction is not complete until the retracted string is absent from the
tree. Each entry is one retirement. `pattern` is a regex matched against
WHITESPACE-FLATTENED text, so a wrapped phrase cannot slip through a
line-based grep. `marker_window` is how many characters around a hit are
searched for a retraction marker: a hit that sits inside an explicit
withdrawal is the record doing its job, not a survival.
Seed the bank when a claim is retired, in the same commit that retires it.

entries.why: positivity was never the test for the leave-one-out arms; the threshold is 2.706 and the arms span a factor of fourteen
a binary count of leave-one-out arms is not a stable summary: the arms are separate likelihoods and carrying them to the adopted kappa leaves one inside the profile's own scatter of the threshold
withdrawn on the same rows it cited

entries.pattern: only the DIFFERENTIAL[a-z ]{0,40}can bias a width
entries.why: beta.py floats a centre per trace and density is constant within a trace, so a collisional shift is absorbed whether or not it varies across the sweep
an intermediate draft of the Orson density-null comparison; the committed like-for-like figure is about 24

entries.pattern: (?:homogeneous terms|these four|components of th\w+ response|transit[^.]{0,60}) adds? exactly|adds? exactly[^.]{0,60}transit
entries.why: the guided transit kernel is a squared Lorentzian entering the width at second order (results/transit_additivity.csv temperature_exponent_band 0.97 to 0.98), so the four-term exact-additivity model is retired; exact additivity survives for the Lorentzian pair alone. Survived 14 board rounds in files no round was pointed at, and two clean-sweep greps missed it on grammatical number
